opinions.text: D. C. N. D. Fla. [Probable jurisdiction noted, 507 U. S. 907.] Motion of the Acting Solicitor General for divided argument granted in part. A total of 30 minutes for oral argument is allotted to the Acting Solicitor General, and a total of 15 minutes for oral argument is allotted to the De Grandy plaintiffs. Motion of Florida and the state officials for divided argument denied. A total of 45 minutes for oral argument is allotted to Florida and the state officials.
